title: Gateway Status card RTT/RTTsd/Loss hardening
acceptance_criteria: Gateway summary parses RTT/Loss from multiple ping output formats including reduced summaries.
Gateway summary derives probe target from DHCP lease routers when route next-hop is unavailable.
Gateway probe attempts multiple ping command variants and falls back to generate when show ping is unsupported.
Backend tests cover parser and fallback behavior.
Runtime smoke checks pass after backend restart.
assumptions: Some VyOS builds output ping stats without mdev/stddev fields.
DHCP WAN default routes can be reported as default dev <iface> without explicit next-hop.
Unrelated dirty files in the working tree are pre-existing and out of scope for this hotfix.

tasks.notes: Hardened route parser, ping metric parsing, DHCP lease gateway extraction, and ping command fallbacks.
Added parser/fallback tests and ran targeted backend suites.
Manual review completed; no API contract changes introduced.

commands.test: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_gateway_summary.py tests/test_system_lldp_parsing.py tests/test_system_dashboard_temperature.py tests/test_safe_apply.py
